aboutus.Учим программировать так же, как учат чи: We teach programming the same way people learn to read
aboutus.«Новый Алгоритм» с 2020 года обучает дет: Since 2020, «New Algorithm» has been teaching children, teenagers, and adults programming and digital literacy in Khujand and Dushanbe, and then helping graduates find their first job in IT.
aboutus.Мы начали в марте 2020 года, на пике пан: We started in March 2020, at the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic, with programming courses for children in Khujand. Parents and children saw the results and trusted us, and in August 2020 we opened a branch in Dushanbe.
aboutus.Спрос на качественное IT-образование сре: The demand for quality IT education among young people is growing, which is why since May 2021 we have been working with international organizations and grant programs. We hold meetings and presentations at universities and schools, and receive more than 300 applications for each course, carefully selecting our students.
aboutus.Кроме hard skills мы проводим тренинги п: In addition to hard skills, we conduct soft skills training with certified mentors and experts.
aboutus.Начало работы в Худжанде — обучение дете: Started operations in Khujand — teaching children programming during the height of the pandemic.
aboutus.Собственные IT-хакатоны и курсы с трудоу: Our own IT hackathons and courses with employment opportunities for graduates.
